web_events.query: China PMI economic data this week
web_events.answer: China's Caixin Services PMI slipped to 50.4 in July, indicating a slowdown in the services sector and missing market expectations. The RatingDog China general services PMI also fell to 50.4 in July, marking the slowest expansion in 10 months. Both readings suggest a deceleration in business activity and new orders, with companies citing softer domestic demand.
